QuestInfo.name: One Step A-Head 2
QuestInfo.0: With all the strange occurrences in Masteria and New Leaf City, Lita Lawless must be busy! I'll bet that she's willing to accept my help...maybe I can earn some mesos in the process! A quick jaunt to the Kerning City subway and I'll be on my way to New Leaf City!
QuestInfo.1: I spoke with Lita, and she told me the tragic origin of the #o9400549#. He was a former warrior of Crimsonwood Keep that was experimented on by the mysterious Alchemist, the same one who corrupted the Krakians. He now roams the Phantom Forest, and I must defeat him and bring his #t4031903# head to Lita as proof of my triumph!
QuestInfo.2: It was a tough fight, but I brought down the mighty horseman and returned his #t4031903# to Lita. I wonder how many other lives the mysterious Alchemist has ruined...

item.0: Hmm, looks like you're not yet finished.  I asked you to beat the #o9400549# and bring me his #t4031903# as proof. I can understand if you want to rest; just be sure to get them all before you return to me.
